jobs.description:
HENNIG ARZNEIMITTEL, headquartered in Flörsheim am Main, is a modern, medium-sized pharmaceutical company with over 300 employees and part of the Italian family-owned Final Group. To strengthen our team, we are looking for an employee (m/f/div) for the position of Legal & Compliance Officer / Specialist (m/f/d)

Job overview

The Legal & Compliance Officer / Specialist serves as a trusted business partner to management and internal stakeholders, providing legal guidance and ensuring that business activities are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, industry standards and internal policies. The role supports the development of a strong governance and compliance culture while enabling sustainable business growth.

Key Responsibilities

- Provide day-to-day legal and compliance advice to executive management and all functions (Production, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, HR, Commercial and Business Development, Finance, etc.);
- Draft, review and support the negotiation of commercial agreements, including NDAs, licensing, supply, distribution, developing, service and manufacturing agreements and other legal documents;
- Monitor applicable laws, regulations and industry standards, assessing their impact on the company’s business activities;
- Develop, implement and continuously improve legal, compliance and corporate governance policies and procedures and internal controls;
- Ensure compliance with applicable pharmaceutical and healthcare regulations, including pharmaceutical advertising, interactions with healthcare professionals and healthcare organisations, anti-bribery and anti-corruption requirements, data protection regulations and relevant industry codes.
- Develop and execute compliance monitoring activities, compliance audits and risk assessments, ensuring appropriate corrective and preventive actions where required;
- Promote a strong culture of integrity and compliance through training, communication and awareness initiatives across the organization;
- Manage intellectual property matters, legal documentation systems and contract lifecycle management;
- Coordinate litigation, disputes and external legal counsel as required and act as the primary interface to the Holding’s Legal & Compliance function.

Your Profile

- Master’s degree in Law or equivalent legal qualification
- 4-5 years of professional experience in Legal and Compliance within the pharmaceutical, healthcare or another highly regulated industry
- Solid understanding of pharmaceutical regulations, healthcare compliance requirements, data protection laws and corporate governance principles
- Strong commercial mindset with the ability to provide pragmatic, solution-oriented legal advice while effectively managing legal and compliance risks
- High level of integrity, independence, sound judgement and professional credibility
- Excellent knowledge of English and German, both written and spoken, Italian is an advantage
- Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with a high level of attention to detail
- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across functions and management levels
- Experience working in an international and cross-functional environment is preferred

What we offer

- A truly strategic leadership role with high visibility and direct impact on company growth
- Close collaboration with an international group structure (Italian parent company)
- Entrepreneurial environment with significant scope for shaping the function and processes
- Competitive compensation package including performance-based incentives
- Up to 2 days of remote work per week

Job Description

As part of the Arvato Group, we are seeking new team members for ATC Computer Transport & Logistics GmbH**, Hessenring 15L in 64546 Mörfelden-Walldorf. ATC is a global logistics, white-glove, and technical services specialist for data centres. For over 45 years, we've helped deliver Europe's data centres safely, securely, and right the first time. Our work includes specialist IT transport and relocations, as well as full data centre commissioning and decommissioning.

As a company within the Arvato Group, we benefit from the strength, scale, and global expertise of one of the world's leading supply chain and technology partners. What truly sets us apart, however, is our people. We invest in training, development, and continuous improvement, and we take pride in building long-term relationships with our clients and teams across Europe.

Data Centre Installers (DCIs) provide an essential service to our clients across Europe. They work inside our clients’ data centres delivering, positioning, and installing server racks to build their cloud infrastructure. Safety, security and customer service are the priorities for all ATC employees. Are you on it?

Your Responsibilities:

- Hardware Setup: Unloading, unpacking with power tools and positioning customers’ IT hardware (server racks). Cabling server racks by patching and dressing fibre and copper cables.
- Procedure Compliance: Following clients’ procedures and requirements, including health and safety, and security.
- Communication: Communicating with costumers, colleagues, managers, planners, team leaders and supervisors, in a consistent, timely, and efficient manner.
- Daily Reporting: Completing daily checklists and providing reports on daily activities or tasks.

Qualifications

- Valid class B driving licence with a good driving record
- Experience with Microsoft Word, Excel, Teams and Email

jobs.occupation: International Clinician Scientist (f/d/m) for iPRACTIS (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description:
Die Medizinische Hochschule Hannover (MHH), mit rund 10.000 Beschäftigten größter Landesbetrieb des Landes Niedersachsen, ist eine universitäre Einrichtung für Forschung und Lehre in der Human- und Zahnmedizin und ein Universitätsklinikum der Supramaximalversorgung. Forschung, Lehre, Krankenversorgung und Administration arbeiten im Integrationsmodell auf dem MHH-Campus Hand in Hand.
About us

Hannover Medical School (MHH) is offering positions in the international clinician scientist program (iPRACTIS), a unique opportunity for internationally mobile researchers with a completed medical degree outside of Germany. Over three years, you will gain experience in translational research while working towards medical degree recognition in Germany.

iPRACTIS supports internationally trained researchers aiming to build careers in academic medicine. Over three years, participants will deepen their research experience on a translational research project while working towards integration into the German academic and healthcare system.

We offer

The international clinician scientist program iPRACTIS offers:

- 36 months of structured clinical and scientific training based on an individually tailored career plan
- Individualized support in navigating the process of medical degree recognition in Germany and developing German language proficiency
- Funding for materials, travel, and publication
- Individualized support from a personalized mentoring team
- A curriculum to acquire key competencies [including data management and analysis, GCP clinical investigator certification (GCP-Prüfarztkurs), project management]
- Regular evaluations and feedback meetings
- A full onboarding program and integration into a strong Clinician Scientist Network

Clinical expectations: Participants will achieve recognition of their medical qualifications along with sufficient German language skills for clinical practice, allowing future specialist training and medical practice in Germany.

Research expectations: Participants will develop as a R2 researcher (according to the European Framework for Research Careers), including submitting their first third-party funding application. Participants who complete this process will be ready to pursue an independent research career (R3) in roles such as assistant professor, principal investigator, or junior group leader.

Eligibility requirements

To apply, candidates must:

- Hold a completed medical degree (from outside Germany)
- Have initial research experience (completed R1 to early R2 based on European Framework for Research Careers)
- Have not yet completed specialist clinical training (residency or German 'Facharzt' / 'Weiterbildung' equivalent)
- Be committed to pursuing a career combining clinical practice and research

In order to consider your application, we require that you submit the completed "iPRACTIS Application Template" (download) as well as a cover letter and detailed resume (in table format), a declaration of consent and copies of certificates (medical examination certificates, doctoral degree certificates, high school diplomas, and other relevant certificates and documents. If the documents are not in German or English, a certified translation is requested). Please submit your application as a single PDF file directly to practis@mh-hannover.de. More information can be found at iPRACTIS.

External applications for iPRACTIS positions will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The deadline for internal applications is 05.01.2027.
For questions, please reach out to Dr. Thorsten Saenger: practis@mh-hannover.de.

jobs.occupation: Forklift Driver / High Rack Forklift Driver (m/f/d) – Gießen, Germany (Gabelstaplerfahrer/in)
jobs.description:
If you are thinking about a new professional opportunity, then we should talk! For a large international logistics project near Gießen, Germany, we are currently looking for several forklift drivers / high rack forklift drivers (m/f/d). You can expect a modern workplace, an international team and long term career opportunities in a fast growing company. Sounds interesting? Then we look forward to receiving your application  

Your Profile 
• Valid forklift license preferred
• Experience in high rack warehouses is an advantage
• Additional qualification for high rack forklifts (Level 2) is a plus
• English skills are sufficient
• Willingness to work shifts and a reliable working style 

Your Tasks 
• Operating forklifts and high rack forklifts
• Loading and unloading trucks
• Internal transport of goods and pallets
• General warehouse and logistics activities 

Your Benefits 
• Attractive salary starting from approx. 2700€ gross plus possible allowances
• Net salary around 1920€ depending on tax class
• Long term perspective with very good chances of contract extension
• Support with finding accommodation through hello jobs
• Modern international working environment
• Fast and uncomplicated application process 

Working Hours 
• 37.5 hours per week in a shift system
• Early shift: 07:00 – 14:00
• Late shift: 14:00 – 21:00/22:00
• Two Saturdays per month required 

How to Successfully Apply With Us 
• Fill out the application form in just a few clicks and send us your CV in English or German
• You will receive feedback from hello jobs by email with the next steps
• We will contact you as quickly as possible by phone or WhatsApp if we believe your profile fits one of our open positions
• If your application is not successful this time, we will of course inform you by email
• If everything fits after the first conversation with your hello jobs recruiter, you will start the selection process with the German company
• After successfully completing the process, you will receive your written job offer and nothing will stand in the way of your new job in Germany  

About hello jobs 
You are at the center of our passion: As an international professional recruitment agency, hello jobs supports you throughout your professional journey. Our experienced recruiting team understands the requirements of today’s international job market. 

We believe in real partnerships – between candidates and companies as well as between our team and you. Your career goals and personal values are always at the center of our mission.

As a Buyer (m/w/d) for MSI & Interiors R&T projects (Research & Technologies) based in Hamburg Finkenwerder, you will play a central role in shaping the future of aerospace technologies. This full-time position involves developing procurement strategies, managing contracts, and collaborating with international suppliers to accelerate innovative solutions. You will ensure a coherent approach to supply chain management while maintaining a professional relationship with major players in the aeronautical industry. Leveraging market intelligence and supplier performance insights, you will negotiate contracts, secure intellectual property rights, and enable multi-sourcing and competitiveness, all within the boundaries of ethical standards and compliance guidelines. This exciting opportunity provides access to cutting-edge projects and requires a proactive, organized, and communicative professional ready to grow in an industry-defining environment.

Your tasks:

- Coordinate with R&T, engineering, and program teams to design procurement strategies.
- Manage procurement activities such as tenders, negotiations, contract preparation, and amendments.
- Identify potential new partners through sourcing and screening activities.
- Negotiate Cooperation and Research Agreements while securing intellectual property rights.
- Build and maintain a robust network internally and externally to drive innovation and supplier collaboration.
- Oversee supplier relationship management, upholding company ethics and compliance standards.
- Represent the company in international supplier collaborations to foster innovation.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- Hold a degree in Engineering or Business Administration.
- 3 years of experience in procurement, customer service, and project management.
- Demonstrated knowledge in contract management and international negotiations with stakeholders.
- Proficiency in SAP and Google Workspace tools.
- Good understanding of process management and risk management.
- Negotiation-level fluency in English.
- High resilience, organizational skills, and willingness to travel within Europe.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 75.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

Join the dynamic Airbus team as a Repair Services Coordinator (m/w/d) and play a key role in managing end-to-end repair services for proprietary parts in Hamburg Finkenwerder. As part of the Repair, Lease & Exchange Order Management Team, you will handle critical customer interactions, coordinate with global suppliers, and oversee processes to ensure operational excellence. This position is a temporary assignment for one year, offering a unique opportunity to collaborate on projects and optimize service delivery in a fast-paced aerospace environment.

Your tasks:

- Act as the central point of contact for Airbus Proprietary Parts Repair, Lease, and Exchange Services, addressing customer inquiries globally.
- Oversee customer Repair, Lease, and Exchange Orders, ensuring supplier adherence to contractual key performance indicators (KPIs).
- Collaborate with airlines, MROs (Maintenance Repair and Overhaul Organizations), and other stakeholders to manage AOG (Aircraft On Ground) inquiries and orders.
- Analyze customer-specific problems, complaints, and coordinate solutions across supply chain processes (end-to-end).
- Maintain daily communication with repair stations to ensure time, cost, and quality targets for open orders.
- Prepare performance reports detailing claims, processing times, turn-around times, and action trackers.
- Support procurement and sales activities, including material process management for Airbus proprietary parts.
- Lead and support process improvement projects and forecast individual repair station requirements.
VORAUSSSETZUNGEN:

- A degree in technical studies, industrial engineering, business administration, or economic sciences.
- 2 years of professional experience in materials procurement, customer service, supplier management, and process improvement.
- Proficiency in tools like MS Excel, MS Office, SAP, and Google Workspace.
- Fluent English communication skills (negotiation level).
- Ability to analyze data and prepare reports effectively.
- Exceptional organizational, problem-solving, and resilience skills.
- Capability to handle multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
Benefits:

- An unlimited employment contract
- 35-hour workweek
- 30 days of annual leave
- An annual salary of around 72.000 €
- An attractive package following the Equal Pay model
- Flexible handling of overtime through compensatory time-off or payment

Your Tasks

- Design and development of thermal control systems
- Conceptual design, sizing, verification and validation of thermal control systems according to customer requirements and feasibility with regard to manufacturing, integration, cost, schedule, quality and risk
- Thermal analysis including the creation of thermal models, verification and assessment of analysis results
- Hardware definition based on the chosen thermal control design solutions and product ownership during implementation and verification
- Support of reviews (from system to equipment level) and presentation of work results to internal and external customers
- Technical supervision of thermal hardware sub-contractors and support of the subcontractor manager
- Support of system engineers during design, development and implementation at system and sub-system level
- Support of project management office with work planning and progress reporting
Your Qualifications

- Degree in engineering with a major in aerospace engineering or comparable qualifications
- Several years of professional experience in space thermal sub-system engineering is preferred
- Experience in the design of thermal control systems, spacecraft thermal engineering and analysis for spacecraft is preferred
- Strong problem-solving skills
- High motivation and proactive involvement with a strong passion for space and spacecraft engineering
- Strong communication and negotiation skills (preferably English and German)
- Experience in subcontractor management is preferred
- In-depth knowledge of ESATAN-TMS, or a similar thermal analysis software
- Used to work in an international environment
